summary: Check pip is available with python3 -m pip -V; if you get No module named pip, install python3-pip or bootstrap it with get-pip.py --user.
questions: How do I check if pip is installed for my Python?
How do I fix No module named pip?
How do I install pip without root?

answer_card.title: Make sure pip is available
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
python3 -m pip -V
```
If it prints a pip version, you're set. If you get `No module named pip`, install the OS package (for example `python3-pip`) or:
```console
curl https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -o get-pip.py
python3 get-pip.py --user
```
You may need to configure the user site directory afterward.
